name: LaShae Sharp-Collins

items.text: In October 2022, a student in her San Diego State Africana Studies class posted on Instagram an assignment asking students to create a "slave persona", and others objected. The department chair said students were never required to dress as slaves or speak in "broken English", as some outlets reported. No official finding was reported.
items.why: This is a classroom assignment in her teaching job. No finding of wrongdoing was reported, and it has no clear bearing on any of the criteria, such as abuse of office, self-dealing or lying about her record.

for_review: The Daily Aztec pages loaded only in part, so I did not read their full bodies. Details from search snippets were left out of the text. These include the report that she canceled the in-class presentation part, that she denied one student's request for an alternative, and that she referred the paper's questions to the department chair. The NY Post and KFMB/Fox23 coverage could not be opened. I did not find her own public response beyond the chair's statement. The search on the owner's named sites returned nothing about her. A reviewer could check the assignment text and any SDSU finding.
